persona: Inventory controller at a 3PL warehouse moving up to shift-level warehouse operations
resumeText:
Ramesh Yadav | Bhiwandi, Maharashtra | ramesh.yadav@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Inventory Controller, Konkan Warehousing & Logistics Pvt Ltd, Bhiwandi (2022 - present)
- Ran daily cycle counts across 4,000 bin locations and reconciled variances with the client.
- Raised inventory accuracy from 97.2% to 99.4% through bin audits and root-cause checks.
- Received inbound containers, checked quantity against the ASN and completed GRN creation and put-away in the WMS.
- Recorded stock transfers and adjustments daily in Increff WMS for an apparel client.
- Supervised a team of 14 pickers and packers on the B2C pick and pack line during sale events.
- Prepared the daily stock and TAT report in Excel for the site manager.

Warehouse Associate, Shree Ganesh Logistics, Thane (2020 - 2022)
- Handled loading and unloading and labelled cartons for dispatch.

SKILLS
5S, warehouse safety, MS Excel, Increff WMS, forklift basics

EDUCATION
B.Com, University of Mumbai, 2020
